messages:
celine: Heads-up: our bulk key-rotation job from Console is showing weird quota attribution flips and duplicate meter entries in billing. Saw it during the nightly run. Anyone familiar?

harry: Oof. Is that the new bulk-rotate feature we shipped for org admins?

mina: Yep. The flow issues a sequence of exchange calls for each key; some go through the proxy and others hit the token-exchange service directly. We see mixed `effective_identity` downstream.

aditya: Concrete symptom: for ~3% of rotated keys we get two meter records: one under the old project (rotate call) and one under org-owner (exchange callback). Billing double-counts a tiny fraction.

celine: Also telemetry: our attribution pipeline correlates by trace id but the rotate worker spawns parallel async sub-requests which lose trace continuity when retried. Sampling exposed it.

harry: So two problems: (1) header/claim loss causing attribution to fallback to org-owner, (2) duplicate counting from retry/async fan-out.

mina: For (1) mitigation: make Console attach a signed `X-Rotation-Origin` header with `project_id` & `key_id` and have auth-proxy preserve and verify it. For (2) we need idempotence keys on the rotate job and de-dup logic in metering.

aditya: I want to argue for token-binding instead of header glue long-term: bind `pjt` claim into the rotated token so downstream services can deterministically attribute even if headers are rewritten. But that'll take migration.

celine: Short-term plan proposal: 1) quick Console patch to send signed header on bulk rotate (canary), 2) auth-proxy passthrough + verify signature, 3) rotate-worker: emit `rotation_op_id` and use it as metering id to dedupe, 4) run a backfill to remove dup meters and reclassify the 24h window.

harry: Also add metrics: `rotation_attrib_fallback_count` and `rotation_meter_dupes_total` and a Grafana card under Console -> Key Ops for oncall.

mina: UX note: update the bulk-rotate modal with a short disclaimer: "During rotation some usage may temporarily show under the org owner while operations settle. This does not change your committed usage."

aditya: Add a checkbox for "dry-run" too so customers can preview attribution before committing.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: console-header-patch (canary) -> expected 18m to green.

analytics-bot: FYI added a saved query `billing.duplicate_meters_by_rotation_op` and a dashboard panel. Linking PR in the incident doc.

harry: For the metering dedupe, suggest using `rotation_op_id` as `idempotency_key` in the metering write path. If metering service sees same key within 48h drop duplicates.

mina: We should also add an alert: if `rotation_meter_dupes_total / rotation_ops_total > 0.5%` page SRE. That gives an early signal during rollouts.

celine: I'll own the backfill job to reclassify and clean dup meters once the API fallback + dedupe land. Will post the runbook and timeline.

aditya: For token-binding roadmap: draft a migration plan where token_v=2 includes `pjt` and services accept both for 90 days. We'll need SDK bump and partner notices. Add to Q2 infra roadmap.

harry: One more API debate: should the rotate API be synchronous (blocking) or async-only with status polling? Async makes retry/fanout easier but complicates trace continuity. Thoughts?

mina: Prefer async with strong `rotation_op_id` propagated in every subcall and set `traceparent` on spawned jobs so trace joins work. Plus use a short lived correlation record in authn-cache for extra attribution fallback.

celine: OK plan accepted: async rotate + idempotency + signed header + proxy verification + dedupe + backfill + dashboard + UX copy. I'll open PRs and the incident ticket INC-1733-rotate-attrib.

deploy-bot: console patch canary is green.

harry: Nice. I'll monitor the new dashboard and tweak alert thresholds if we get noise. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
